<entry id="N00316">
<head-word>נָוֶה</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>,
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown"> נָוָה f. (b. h.; = נאוה</xref></language-reference>, v. 
<xref rid="A00627">אָוָה II</xref>) 
<italic>marked-off place, circle, dwelling</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. IX, 13
<sup>c</sup> bot. (ref. to Jer. XXV, 30) בשביל נָוֵיהוּ on account of his (destroyed) dwelling (the Temple); Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 3 (ref. to ואנוהו, Ex. XV, 2) ואין נ' אלא וכ' (not נאה) 
<italic>naveh</italic> means the Temple (ref. to Ps. LXXIX, 7, a. e.). Sot. 9
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Ps. XXXIII, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> אל תקרי נאוה אלא נְוֵה תהלה read not 
<italic>nâvah</italic> (becoming) but 
<italic>n’veh</italic> of glory, i.e. a dwelling of glory is that of the righteous (which no human hand is permitted to destroy).</definition>
<notes> Ib. 47
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Hab. II, 5) לא יִנְוֶה אפי' בנ' שלו he will not be pleasing (popular) even in his own household; B. Bath. 98
<sup>a</sup>; Yalk. Hab. 562. Keth. XIII, 9 מוציאין מנ' הרעה נ' היפה וכ' a husband may compel his wife to move with him from a worse to a better house (and style of living). Ib. הנ' היפה בודק, v. בָּדַק. Ib. 110
<sup>b</sup> לאיתויי … לנ' הרע including even a change from a better to a worse household; Arakh. 3
<sup>b</sup>.—Trnsf. 
<italic>climate; health</italic>. Gen. R. s. 64 [read:] מפני מה לא גזרו על הנ' … שנָוָהּ רע why did they not forbid (as unclean) the air of Gerariké? Because its climate is bad; Y. Shebi. VI, 36
<sup>c</sup> bot. מפני מה לא גזרו על הרוח … שנִיוְיָהּ וכ'. Ib. והרי עזה ניויה יפה but there is Gaza whose climate is healthy. Y. B. Bath. II, 13
<sup>c</sup> top נִיאוֹ רע (prob. to be read: נִיוְיוֹ) a tree makes the neighborhood unhealthy; v. נוֹי 2.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00323">
<head-word>נֶוֶול</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (next w.) 
<italic>contemptibility, degeneracy</italic>.</definition>

<entry id="N00324">
<head-word>נָוֵול</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, נָוֵל (cmp. נָבֵל) 
<italic>to be disfigured, look repulsive; to degenerate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sot. XIV, 7 אזלה ונָוְלָה (Var. ונָבְלָה) becomes more and more corrupt.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִוֵּול</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to disfigure; to disgrace</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 154
<sup>a</sup> אי … לנַוְּולוֹ you are not permitted to disgrace him (to search a corpse for tokens of maturity). Sot. I, 6 מעבירים ממנה כדי לנַוְּולָהּ we divest her (of all jewelry) in order to disgrace her. Ned. 66
<sup>a</sup> בנות ישראל … שהעניות מְנַוַּולְתָּן Israel’s daughters are handsome, it is only poverty that makes them appear homely. Sifré Deut. 240 (ref. to נבלה, Deut. XXII, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> לא עצמה בלבד נִוְּולָה וכ' she has disgraced not only herself but all virgins of Israel; a. e.—Part.</definition>
<notes> pass. מְנוּוָּל; f. מְנוּוֶּלֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְנוּוָּלִין, מְנוּוָּלוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Pes. VI, 33
<sup>a</sup>, sq. זבח מ' (not מזבח) a repulsive (putrid) sacrifice (Sabb. 116
<sup>b</sup> מוטלין כנבלה). 
<pgbrk id="pg885" />Naz. IV, 5, a. e., v. אֶפֶשׁ. Tosef. Sot. II, 3 הרי היא בדוקה ומנ' she (by refusing to drink the searching waters) is already searched and disgraced, i.e. has admitted her guilt. Y. M. Kat. III, beg. 81
<sup>c</sup>. שלא … מנ' that they may not enter the Sabbath with neglected hair; a. e.—Kidd. 30
<sup>b</sup> אם פגע בך מנ' זה וכ' if that ugly one (the tempter) meets thee, drag him to the house of learning, i.e. overcome evil inclinations by study.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00340">
<head-word>נוּחַ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to rest, lie; to be at ease, rest satisfied</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Sabb. 7
<sup>b</sup> זרק … והלכה ונָחָה וכ' if one threw an object higher than ten handbreadths, and in its course it came to rest in a little hole. Ib. וזרק ונָח על גביו and he threw an object and it came to rest on it. Gen. R. s. 25 כיון שעמד נֹחַ נָחוּ when Noah rose, they rested (submitted to man’s rulership; Yalk. Chr. 1072 נִינּוֹחוּ; Yalk. Gen. 42 נִחֲמָן he appeased them); ib. וכיון שעמד נֹחַ נחו and when Noah rose, they remained undisturbed in their graves; Yalk. Chr. l. c. נינוחו.—Meg. 25
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. יָנוּחוּ לו ברכות וכ' blessings rest upon his head. Sabb. 152
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. תָּנוּחַ … שהנחת וכ' let thy mind be at rest, for thou hast set my mind at rest; a. fr.—Part. נָח, נוֹחַ, f. נוֹחָה; 
<plural-form>pl. נוֹחִים, נוֹחִין; נוֹחוֹת</plural-form> a) 
<italic>resting</italic>. Gen. R. s. 11 אתם נוחין you rest. Y. Erub. III, end, 21
<sup>c</sup>, a. fr. נוֹחֵי נפש whose souls are at rest; a. fr.—b) 
<italic>pleased.</italic> Ab. III, 10 כל שרוח הבריות נ' הימנו וכ' in whom the mind of man finds pleasure, the mind of God finds pleasure. Shebi. X, 9; a. fr.—V. נוֹחַ.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵנִיחַ, הִנִּיחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (fr. יָנַח) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to set at rest; to set down, place</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. l. c. (ref. to Gen. V, 29) או נח זה יְנִיחֵנוּ וכ' either let him be called Noaḥ, then it ought to read, ‘he shall set us at rest’, or Naḥman &c. Sabb. l. c. שהֵנַחְתָּ, v. supra; (Snh. 30
<sup>b</sup> שהתנחת, v. תָּנַח; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20). Ḥull. 91
<sup>b</sup> עלי יַנִּיחַ צדיק וכ' let this righteous man rest his head on me.—B. Kam. III, 1. B. Mets. VI, 6 הַנַּח לפני put it down before me (I will take charge of it). Sabb. 21
<sup>b</sup> להַנִּיחָהּ על פתח וכ' to place it over the entrance &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to leave; to leave alone; to allow.</italic></definition>
<notes> B. Bath. IX, 1 מי שמת וה' בנים וכ' if a person died and left sons and daughters. Ib. 3 ראו מה שה' לנו וכ' see what our father left us. Snh. 30
<sup>a</sup> מעות שה' לו אביו money which his father had left him (without telling him where it was deposited). Pesik. R. s. 26; Yalk. Ps. 884 אבינו ירמיה הרי אתה מַנִּיחֵנוּ שם J., our father, wilt thou leave us there (in Babylonia, without a prophet)?—Bets. 30
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. הַנַּח להם לישראל leave Israel alone (let them do as they please). Yoma I, 4 לא היו מְנִיחִים אותו וכ' they did not let him eat much. Ab. Zar. 10
<sup>b</sup> יַנִּיחֶנָּה, v. נוֹמִי. Ib. 17

<entry id="N00500">
<head-word>נָחַל</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="N00502"> denom. of נַחֲלָה</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> , q. v.) 
<italic>to inherit.</italic></definition>
<notes> B. Bath. VIII, 1 יש נוֹחֲלִין ומַנְחִילִין there are such relations as inherit from and eventually transmit to one another (e. g. father and son); ויש נוחלין ולא מנחילין and some inherit, but (when they die) do not transmit their estate to those whose natural heirs they would have been (e. g. son and mother). Kidd. I, 10 ונוֹחֵל את הארץ and shall inherit the land (of life everlasting). Sifré Num. 133 יודע … שהבנות נוֹחֲלוֹת Moses knew that daughters (in the absence of sons) are legal heirs. Midr. Till. to Ps. V, beg. (ref. to Num. XXI, 19) משנָחֲלוּ ע"ז בא עליהם וכ' when they adopted idolatry, the angel of death came upon them. Ib. נחלו 
<pgbrk id="pg895" />להק"בה לאלוה והוא נ' וכ' they adopted the Lord as God, and he adopted them as a people; ib. ממתנה נָחַלְתִּי לאל through the gift (of the well in the desert) I adopted God; מתוך שנתן לי הקב"ה הבאר נחלתי אותו (ed. Bub.) because the Lord gave me the well as a gift, I adopted him; Erub. 54
<sup>a</sup> וכיון שניתנה לו במתנה נְחָלֹו אל and since it (the Law) is given him as a gift, the Lord claims him as his own; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִנְחִיל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to transmit by legal succession; to give in possession</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. l. c., v. supra. Tosef. B. Mets. XI, 32, a. fr. שעל מנת כן ה' וכ' for Joshua gave possession of the land with such provisions (restricting the rights of ownership). Ukts. III, 12 עתיד הקב"ה להַנְחִיל וכ' (Snh. 100
<sup>a</sup> ליתן) the Lord will in the hereafter give every righteous man possession of &c. B. Bath. 114
<sup>b</sup> אין הבן יורש את אמו בקבר להנחיל וכ' a son in the grave does not succeed his mother so as to transmit his estate to his paternal brothers; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00502">
<head-word>נַחֲלָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> חוּל)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>turn, lot</italic>,] 
<italic>inheritance, right of succession</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. VIII, 4 אחד הבן ואחד הבת בנ' the same law of succession applies to sons and (eventually) to daughters (v. ib. 122
<sup>b</sup>). Bekh. VIII, 1, v. בְּכוֹר. Midr. Till. to Ps. V, 1 (play on נחילות ib.) על הנ' שנחלתם וכ' for the possession which you took from me, and for the possession which I took from you; a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>the central sanctuary at Shiloh</italic> or 
<italic>at Jerusalem</italic>. Tosef. Zeb. XIII, 20; Zeb. 119
<sup>a</sup>, sq.; Meg. 10
<sup>a</sup>, contrad. to מְנוּחָה.—
<plural-form>Pl. נַחֲלוֹת</plural-form>. B. Bath. VIII, 2 סדר נ' וכ' the following is the order of succession (among relatives). Ib. 117
<sup>a</sup> משונה נחלה זו מכל נ' שבעולם this division of inheritance (after the conquest of Canaan) is different from all other successions; a. fr.—Yalk. Ps. 629, v. נְחִילָה.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00503">
<head-word>נָחַם</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. נוּחַ)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be at ease</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 20 (homiletic interpret. of נָחָם, Ex. XIII, 17) אמר הקב"ה איני מתנחם וכ' the Lord said, I shall not be contented, until &c., for we read ולא נָחַם (perhaps meant for נִחַם 
<italic>Nif.</italic>).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיחֵם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to comfort, console</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. Naḥ., p. 128
<sup>a</sup> א"ל הקב"ה אני ואתם נלך ונְנַחֲמֶנָּה the Lord said to them (the prophets), Myself and you, let us go and comfort her (Jerusalem); ib. נַחֲמוּהָ עמי וכ' comfort her, O my people; comfort her, you on high (angels) &c. Ib. הקב"ה שלחני אצלך לנַחֲמֵךְ the Lord sent me to thee (Jerusalem) to comfort thee. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> נַחֲמוּנִי נחמוני עמי comfort me, comfort me, O my people. Pesik. R. s. 30 ונכנסו חביריו לנַחֲמוֹ and his friends came in to comfort him; אם על אשתו מְנַחֲמִים לו וכ' if it is for the loss of his wife that they seek to console him, and he refuses to be consoled &c. Midd. II, 2 השוכן בבית הזה יְנַחֶמְךָ may He who resides in this house console thee. Y. Gitt. V, 47
<sup>c</sup> top; Y. Dem. IV, 24
<sup>a</sup> bot. ומְנַחֲמִין אבילי וכ' and you must comfort the gentile mourners (of your place) as well as the Jewish mourners; Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39
<sup>c</sup> bot. ניחמים (corr. acc.); Tosef. Gitt. V (III), 5; a. fr.—מְנַחֵם 
<italic>the consoling friend of the mourner</italic>. Yalk. Prov. 947 בבית האבל בחול פריס מנ' ויהיב לאבל … יש לה מנ' פריס מנ' וכ' in the house of the mourner, on week days, the comforter breaks the bread and gives it to the mourner, as it is written (Lam. I, 17), ‘Zion breaks (the bread) with her own hands, she has no comforter’, but if she had a comforter, the comforter would break it &c.—
<plural-form>Pl. מְנַחֲמִים, מְנַחֲמִין</plural-form>. M. Kat. 27
<sup>a</sup> בית המנ' the room where the comforters meet. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> כיון שניענע … אין מנ' וכ' as soon as the mourner nods with his head (indicating that he accepts their consolations), the friends are no longer permitted to sit with him; a. fr.—Sabb. 152
<sup>a</sup> מת שאין לו מנ' a deceased person that leaves no direct relations to be comforted.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִחַם, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְנַחֵם, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa.</italic> נִתְנַחֵם </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be comforted, accept consolation</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. l. c. מי צריך להִנָּחֵם which of them is in need of being comforted?; ib. להִתְנַחֵם. Snh. 19
<sup>a</sup> תִּתְנֶחָמוּ be comforted. Ib. מִתְנַחֵם מאחרים receiving consolations from others. Pesik. R. l. c. ואינו מתנחם, v. supra. Gen. R. s. 84 מִתְנַחֲמִים על המתים וכ' people accept consolation for dead persons but not for living ones (that have disappeared); a. fr.—Ib. s. 27 (expl. וינחם, Gen. VI, 6) מתנ' אני שבראתי וכ' I have that consolation that I created him (man) to live on earth below &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to seek comfort; to be sorry, regret, reconsider</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. מתנ' אני שעשיתו וכ' I regret that I made him, and that he was placed on earth. Ex. R. s. 45, beg. ואני מתנ' עליו and I am sorry for him (reconsider my judgment). Num. R. s. 23 (ref. to Num. XXIII, 19) לא בן עמרם עשה אותו להִנָּחֵם did not the son of Amram cause him (God) to reconsider (Ex. XXXII, 14); ib. להִתְנַחֵם; Y. Taan. I, 65
<sup>b</sup> bot. שעשה לאל שיִתְנֶחָם; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>consolation, relief</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 11
<sup>b</sup> אל יראה בנֶחָמַת צבור (Yalk. Ex. 264 בנחמות, 
<italic>pl.</italic>) shall not live to see the relief of the community. Pes. 54
<sup>b</sup> (man does not know) יום הנ' what day his relief from trouble will come; a. fr.—Esp. הנ' 
<italic>the comfort</italic> (of Zion), 
<italic>restoration of Israel</italic>. Macc. 5
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. (a euphemistic affirmation) אראה בנ' לא וכ' may I not live to see the consolation, if &c.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> נֶחָמוֹת. Y. Ber. V, beg. 8
<sup>d</sup> the prophets שהיו חותמין … ובדברי נ' who closed their books with words of praise and of consolation (predictions of relief; Bab. ib. 31
<sup>a</sup> תנחומים); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
